## Portraits

Two portraits appear in the margins of this book. Both are
reproduced under the Creative Commons licenses stated below, which
require attribution; the credit lines here and in each figure
caption are given to satisfy that condition.

**Robert Gentleman**, @sec-rrtools.

- File: `images/portraits/gentleman.jpg`
- Photograph by the R Consortium, from 'A View of the Future',
  R/Medicine 2020 Virtual Conference, 2020-09-13
- License: [CC BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/)
- Source: [Wikimedia
  Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Robert_Gentleman_on_R_Consortium.jpg)
- Changes: resized to 400 px on the long edge; metadata stripped

**Hadley Wickham**, @sec-wrangling.

- File: `images/portraits/wickham.jpg`
- Photograph by Hadley Wickham, 2015-11-04
- License: [CC BY-SA
  4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
- Source: [Wikimedia
  Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hadley-wickham2016-02-04.jpg)
- Changes: resized to 400 px on the long edge; metadata stripped

The share-alike term on the Wickham photograph applies to that
image, not to the surrounding text. The book's prose remains CC BY
4.0; the photograph remains CC BY-SA 4.0 and must carry that
license in any redistribution.

### Portraits not included

Slots for Jenny Bryan (@sec-git-solo), JJ Allaire (@sec-quarto)
and Yihui Xie (@sec-rmd-workflow) were planned and are not
filled. No freely licensed photograph of any of the three was
found on Wikimedia Commons, and their personal and employer pages
state no license terms permitting reuse. A photograph being
publicly visible is not a license.

One route remains open and was not taken. rOpenSci licenses its
site content CC BY 4.0 except where otherwise noted, and hosts a
headshot of Jenny Bryan in its own image tree at
`ropensci.org/img/blog-images/2017-12-08-rprofile-jenny-bryan/`.
That notice appears to cover it. The photograph was probably
supplied by the subject rather than created by rOpenSci, so
whether the site-wide grant extends to it is worth confirming with
rOpenSci before use.

Anyone offering a portrait for those chapters, or for Frank
Harrell, Roger Peng, Karl Broman, Carl Boettiger or Friedrich
Leisch, is invited to contact the author. It must be CC BY, CC0,
or supplied with the subject's explicit permission, and this
section must record the photographer, the source and the license
before it ships. Please contact the author for removal if any
attribution here is incorrect.
